findings.description: The KMS key used to encrypt the audit trail bucket does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false. Audit log encryption keys that are never rotated increase the blast radius if key material is ever compromised and violate common regulatory baselines for long-lived cryptographic material.

No policy argument is defined, so AWS applies the default KMS key policy granting the entire AWS account root principal full control over the key (kms:*). Any IAM principal in the account with sufficient IAM permissions can therefore use or administer the key protecting audit data, rather than a narrowly scoped set of administrators and the audit log service.
